weather_scenario_or_phenomenon: Continuous Overcast Skies with Drizzling Rain & High Relative Humidity (>85%, 24-28°C)
agromet_impact_assessment: Prolonged leaf wetness (>6 hours) and high humidity trigger explosive outbreaks of Rice Blast (leaf and neck blast), Sheath Blight, and Cotton Grey Mildew (Dahiya).
mandatory_farmer_advisories: Postpone all chemical spraying until skies clear and rain stops.
Drain excess water from rice fields to prevent sheath blight upward progression.
Hold back top-dressing of chemical nitrogenous fertilizers (Urea) as excessive N escalates fungal blast virulence.
Keep prophylactic fungicides ready: Spray Amistar Top (Azoxystrobin + Difenoconazole) @ 1 ml/L or Contaf (Hexaconazole 5% SC) @ 2 ml/L once rain recedes.
imd_source_attribution: IMD Agromet Advisory Bulletin, RMC Hyderabad & PJTSAU 2025

district_and_agro_climatic_zone: Kurnool & Anantapur, Scarce Rainfall Zone (Rayalaseema, AP)
weather_scenario_or_phenomenon: Dry Spell of 18-20 Days during July-August with Max Temp 35-38°C
agromet_impact_assessment: Severe moisture stress during groundnut flowering and pegging stage causing peg hardening and floral abortion; jassid and thrips flare-up in cotton.
mandatory_farmer_advisories: Operate tractor-drawn or bullock-drawn blade harrow (Danti) in inter-rows to create a dust mulch (soil mulch) which breaks capillary moisture loss from soil.
Apply supplemental protective irrigation using rain-gun or sprinkler systems.
Give foliar spray of 2% Urea (20 g/L) or 2% Potassium Nitrate (KNO3 @ 20 g/L) in early morning or late afternoon to relieve crop water stress.
imd_source_attribution: IMD District Agro-Meteorological Advisory Unit (DAMU) Anantapur & ANGRAU 2025

district_and_agro_climatic_zone: Ludhiana & Patiala, Central Plain Zone, Punjab
weather_scenario_or_phenomenon: Terminal Heat Wave (Max Temp >35°C, 4-5°C above normal) during March (Grain Filling Stage)
agromet_impact_assessment: Terminal heat stress shortens grain-filling duration, induces forced maturity, and causes grain shriveling, reducing 1000-grain test weight and wheat yield by 15-25%.
mandatory_farmer_advisories: Provide light and frequent sprinkler irrigations during evening hours to moderate microclimate canopy temperature.
Foliar spray of 0.2% Potassium Nitrate (KNO3 @ 2 g/L) or 0.2% Alpha-tocopherol at heading and milk stage to enhance thermotolerance.
Avoid flooding fields during windy afternoon hours to prevent crop lodging.
imd_source_attribution: PAU Ludhiana & IMD Agromet Advisory Service New Delhi 2025

district_and_agro_climatic_zone: Hisar & Karnal, Western Plain Zone, Haryana
weather_scenario_or_phenomenon: Severe Cold Wave & Ground Frost Alert (Minimum Temp dropping below 3.0°C in January)
agromet_impact_assessment: Intracellular ice crystal formation leads to cellular rupture, blackened foliage, premature flower drop in mustard, and complete frost blighting of potato vines.
mandatory_farmer_advisories: Provide light irrigation to crops in evening hours; water has high specific heat capacity and raises soil and canopy temperature by 1-2°C.
Create evening smoke around field boundaries (smudging) using dry leaves/straw on the windward side between 11 PM and 5 AM.
Spray soluble sulphur (80% WDG) @ 2.5 g/L or dilute sulphuric acid (0.1% H2SO4) on standing mustard/potato.
imd_source_attribution: IMD Agromet Advisory Unit Chandigarh & CCSHAU Hisar 2025

district_and_agro_climatic_zone: Guntur & Krishna, Krishna-Godavari Delta Zone, AP
weather_scenario_or_phenomenon: Bay of Bengal Depressions / Cyclone Warning with Heavy Rainfall (150-250 mm in 48 hours)
agromet_impact_assessment: Water stagnation, field submergence, lodging of ripe paddy panicles, viviparous grain germination, and rotting of mature cotton bolls.
mandatory_farmer_advisories: Harvest mature standing paddy immediately if crop is at 80-85% maturity and store sheaves in safe elevated sheds.
Open drainage channels and clear field bund outlets immediately to drain standing storm runoff.
For logged ripe paddy fields, spray 5% common salt solution (NaCl @ 50 g/L) on standing panicles to suppress in-situ viviparous sprouting.
Do not apply any fertilizer or chemical sprays until water recedes completely.
imd_source_attribution: Cyclone Warning Centre Visakhapatnam & ANGRAU Amaravati 2025

district_and_agro_climatic_zone: Indore & Ujjain, Malwa Plateau Zone, Madhya Pradesh
weather_scenario_or_phenomenon: Excessive Rainfall Cloudburst (>100 mm in 24 hours) during Sowing Window (July)
agromet_impact_assessment: Vertisol soil saturation and water ponding; seed rot and asphyxiation of germinating soybean seedlings.
mandatory_farmer_advisories: Construct Broad Bed Furrows (BBF) across slopes so excess rainwater drains rapidly into furrows.
If seeds rot and plant stand falls below 60% of optimal, re-sow with early maturing soybean varieties (JS 95-60, NRC 37) as soon as soil permits workable tilth.
Drench collar root zone with Carbendazim 50% WP @ 2 g/L to prevent collar rot.

district_and_agro_climatic_zone: Nashik & Pune, Western Maharashtra Plain Zone
weather_scenario_or_phenomenon: Unseasonal Spring Hailstorm with Gusty Squally Winds (>60 km/h) in February-March
agromet_impact_assessment: Physical mechanical injury, shredding of foliage, lodging of wheat, and bruised onion bulbs prone to secondary bacterial rotting.
mandatory_farmer_advisories: Deploy anti-hail protective netting over high-value vegetable and onion seed crops.
Immediately after hailstorm, spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L + Streptocycline @ 0.1 g/L to heal tissue wounds and prevent bacterial soft rot.
Provide light irrigation to wash off dirt and encourage vegetative recovery.
imd_source_attribution: MPKV Rahuri & IMD Pune Agromet Advisory 2025

weather_scenario_or_phenomenon: High Day Temperatures (>36°C) & Clear Skies during Rabi Paddy Nursery (December-January)
agromet_impact_assessment: Cold night temperatures (<12°C) combined with dry winds cause stunted yellow seedlings (cold injury) in rabi nursery.
mandatory_farmer_advisories: Keep thin layer of water (2-3 cm) in nursery bed during night to insulate roots against chilling, and drain in morning.
Cover nursery beds with polythene sheets supported by bamboo arches during night (greenhouse cover effect).
Spray 0.5% Zinc Sulphate + 1% Urea to boost seedling vigor.
imd_source_attribution: PJTSAU Regional Agricultural Research Station Jagtial 2025

district_and_agro_climatic_zone: Bharatpur & Alwar, Flood Plain Zone, Eastern Rajasthan
weather_scenario_or_phenomenon: Warm, Humid & Cloudy Weather in January (RH >75%, Temp 15-20°C)
agromet_impact_assessment: Ideal environmental trigger for rapid immigration and explosive proliferation of Mustard Aphid (Lipaphis erysimi) and White Rust outbreak.
mandatory_farmer_advisories: Scout crop daily; check central shoot inflorescence for aphid colonies.
If aphid infestation exceeds 20% plants, spray Actara 25% WG (Thiamethoxam) @ 40 g/acre or Dimethoate 30% EC @ 260 ml/acre during late afternoon hours after honeybees return to hives.
Spray Ridomil Gold @ 2 g/L if white rust porcelain pustules appear on lower leaves.

district_and_agro_climatic_zone: Shimla & Solan, Sub-Temperate Hill Zone, Himachal Pradesh
weather_scenario_or_phenomenon: Dense Fog, Continuous Drizzle & Relative Humidity >95% for 72 Hours (Temp 10-18°C)
agromet_impact_assessment: Late Blight Forecasting Alert: 100% favorable conditions for Phytophthora infestans epidemic.
mandatory_farmer_advisories: Apply prophylactic contact fungicide Dithane M-45 (Mancozeb 75% WP) @ 2.5 g/L immediately covering lower and upper leaf surfaces.
If disease lesions have already appeared, spray curative systemic fungicide Ridomil Gold (Metalaxyl-M + Mancozeb) @ 2.5 g/L without delay.
High earthing up to protect developing tubers from zoospores washing down.
imd_source_attribution: ICAR-CPRI Shimla Late Blight Forecasting Warning 2025

weather_scenario_or_phenomenon: Prolonged Intermittent Showers during October-November (Boll Bursting Stage)
agromet_impact_assessment: Moisture inside bursting bolls causes wet boll rot, internal fiber discoloration, seed sprouting, and severe lint staining.
mandatory_farmer_advisories: Pick burst bolls immediately during sunny intervals; dry kapas thoroughly on tarpaulin.
Spray Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5 g/L + Streptocycline @ 0.1 g/L on green bolls to prevent secondary fungal and bacterial boll rots.
Remove rotting ground bolls to prevent inoculum build-up.
imd_source_attribution: ICAR-CICR Nagpur & PDKV Akola Agromet Advisory 2025

district_and_agro_climatic_zone: Cuttack & Puri, East Coast Plain Zone, Odisha
agromet_impact_assessment: Flash flooding of coastal lowlands; submergence of standing paddy crop close to harvest.
mandatory_farmer_advisories: Drain inundated fields rapidly using diesel pump-sets.
Harvest submerged panicles immediately, wash muddy grains with clean water, and sun-dry.
Spray 19:19:19 @ 10 g/L on surviving winter vegetables to revive vegetative growth after flood waters recede.
